o: Andrew Yancy has been bounced from the Miami Police Department and is now a health inspector in the Keys. After stumbling upon a case that begins with a human arm fished up by tourists, he realizes that if he can prove murder, he'll be back in. He just needs to get past a trove of Floridian oddballs and one bad monkey.

eps.o: When tourists on a fishing charter in Key West, Florida, discover a human arm, suspended detective Andrew Yancy takes the case.

eps.t: A Hundred Bucks Says You Won't
eps.o: Caitlin meets with Yancy to discuss her suspicions about her stepmother Eve. Yancy learns of Eve's secret boyfriend.

eps.t: Nobody Said He Was Alvin Einstein
eps.o: Yancy and Rosa continue their search for more information about Nick. Caitlin confronts Eve, leading to a shocking revelation.

eps.t: Nothing's Wrong with It, I Just Don't Need It Anymore
eps.o: A flashback reveals Eve and Nick's origins, how Yancy got suspended, and Nick and Izzy's nefarious business dealings.
Yancy makes a crucial realization as he goes into hiding. The Dragon Queen asks Egg about Neville.

eps.t: Yo, Would You Tell Ms. Chase I Still Love Her Like Crazy
eps.o: In need of help, Yancy turns to Rogelio. Bonnie goes on the run. The Dragon Queen confronts Nick and Eve.
Rogelio and Yancy find themselves in an explosive situation. Eve negotiates with the Dragon Queen.

eps.t: The Russian Mob Is Very Active in Key West
eps.o: With Caitlin and Rosa's help, Yancy cooks up a new plan to get Nick and Eve back to Miami.

eps.t: You Really Don't Want to Kill This Scrumptious Little Puppy
eps.o: Yancy learns that his plan has gone awry, leaving Rosa in danger. Eve and the Dragon Queen have a reckoning.
The aftermath of the reckoning has shocking repercussions.
